test.result: 49 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy on the feed-health and session-runner modules passed.

implemented: The feed monitor tracks packet-ID duplicates, sequence gaps, last available packet, successful heartbeat, disconnects, reconnects and dropped updates.
Feed-health snapshots are immutable/idempotent and stored in the durable forward-session journal before decisions.
The session runner forces NO_TRADE on stale quote/heartbeat, gaps, disconnects, or drops, and places all counters/reason codes in the closed session result.
Fault-injection tests verify no strategy or execution adapter runs on stale feed, and restart-safe journal facts preserve the counters in the session record.
blockers: The current Kite polling payload has no packet sequence number or provider disconnect/reconnect callbacks, so live gaps/reconnect/drop counts cannot yet be populated automatically from the configured source.
PacketDeduper's packet-ID/sequence memory itself is process-local; only recorded health snapshots survive restart. Persisted packet-level deduplication is not connected to the capture archive.
scope_note: Injection-driven fail-closed health gating and durable session evidence are implemented. Automated health collection from an active feed and packet-level deduplication recovery remain incomplete.
